summary: Named only on a Georgia tower list as 'run creek' in Long County (code GA212, no register code); absent from NHLR's Georgia register, and no source found describes it.

evidence.supports: List row: run creek at 31.64487, -81.66327 in Long County, code GA212, with no register code
Other list rows carry register codes, for example nhlr and gfc-610
The list numbers its entries up to GA427
The list's author says names for towers 73 and above are the author's own creation; GA212 is one of them
evidence.quote: For towers 73 and above, names are my creation.

evidence.supports: Source is a list titled Georgia lookout towers
NHLR's Georgia register counts 29 registered lookouts
evidence.quote: There are 29 lookouts registered in Georgia.

notes_for_editor: Only one source names this site: the tnlandforms Georgia list (2016 revision), a single row with name, coordinates, county and elevation-like figure 41 (feet, unlabelled; not used in the story). The name is lowercase in the source and carries no 'Lookout Tower' suffix. The list's own note says names for towers 73 and above are the author's creation, and GA212 falls in that range, so 'run creek' is the list's label, not an official name; the story says so. Of the 427 list rows, 301 carry a register code (counted from the page), so 'unlike many entries' holds. Not in the NHLR Georgia register. No WebSearch hit, Wikipedia page or FFLA chapter report found anything on this site (one combined WebSearch covered it with the other two). Status, access and history are unknown and left out. The story is short on purpose; padding would invent facts.
